The matrixctrl and crosspatch objects offer user interfaces for controlling the matrix~ object.

add connections to matrix~ directly and observe crosspatch...
connect the left outlet of crosspatch to left inlet of matrix~ -- everything will be kept in sync
Use the crosspatch object for a patching interface to matrix~. When connected to a single matrix~, crosspatch updates its state if you change matrix~, and vice versa.
To see the current contents of a matrix~ as a dictionary, use the dumpconnections message. A dictionary will be sent out the rightmost outlet.
set the state of the matrix with these dictionaries

The matrix~ object can receive dictionaries to configure its state. When receiving a dictionary, all previous connections are cleared and replaced by the connections in the dictionary. You can also set some attributes including the default gain and ramp time.
